verdict.rationale: Khoj's docs show first-party support for OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini API keys, local models via Ollama, and any API-backed LLM via LiteLLM. Admins can add several chat models and switch between them, and agents can each be assigned their own chat model. OpenRouter is not named, and per-conversation model switching is only implied by "switch between for your different use-cases" rather than documented as a conversation-level control. missing for 10: explicit OpenRouter support, documented per-conversation model switching, independent hands-on corroboration of multi-provider switching.

support.subject: As a power user, I can plug in multiple model providers — Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, and more — and switch models per agent or per conversation

citations.quote: Set OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, or GEMINI_API_KEY to your API key if you want to use OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini commercial chat models
Add all the chat models you want to try, use and switch between for your different use-cases.
Create agents with custom knowledge, persona, chat model and tools to take on any role.
Using LiteLLM with Khoj makes it possible to turn any LLM behind an API into your personal AI agent.
This makes it possible to use chat models from Ollama with Khoj.
